# geocode value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:geocodeValue`](gmeow-geocodeValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/geocodeValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The string value of a geocode in its reference frame — the canonical literal carrier. Per-system properties ([`plusCode`](gmeow-plusCode.md), what3words, …) are convenience accessors; a single [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) instance carries exactly one code value (enforced by SHACL).

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional
